purpose: Re-run preselected preserved and compact CVAE variants on training-calibrated climate inputs; not a claim that any model must fail.
selection: Preselected variants, each trained with three fixed seeds and the same 1800-second budget. Checkpoint selection uses validation only; preserve all finite checkpoints in the frozen reporting evaluation.
confirmation: If the compact variant is non-degenerate for all three seeds, retrain its seed-17 model from scratch for 3600 seconds without changing hyperparameters. This is a separately labelled longer-budget run, not part of the matched-budget comparison.
test_evaluation: Freeze checkpoints, protocol and evaluator hashes after validation and before test. Reporting years have previously been inspected in the project; no claim of a pristine development-unseen test. Do not tune using these reporting results.
comparison_scope: Evaluate distribution and temporal metrics of individual generated paths. Existing XGBoost/bootstrap point metrics and this VAE path score answer different questions; no direct ranking from unlike metrics.
hybrid_path_comparator: After the freeze, evaluate the frozen corrected hybrid ensemble with the same path metrics and training-only thresholds. For each prior seed 101, 102 and 103, draw one ensemble member per reporting/validation year using only a seeded RNG. These are marginal/path diagnostics, not event forecasts or evidence of coherent joint weather.
data_processing: National scaling targets and denominator restricted to 1980-2015. No shared sampling is introduced in the maintained XGBoost/bootstrap generator. The exploratory CVAE retains its pre-existing joint architecture.
limitations: Time-bounded CPU experiments may stop before convergence
A partial first epoch is labelled and cannot establish model failure
No new architecture or loss is selected from test data
One dataset and machine, no general superiority claim
